value_index.basis: [B] TEAM HEURISTIC, not a cited statistic. Relative production/market value of one season of each crop, rice = 1.0. Upland cash crops (maize, mungbean, sesame, peanut, watermelon) share one lower value because the team has no price series to separate them; soybean is lower because domestic soybean competes with imports (see market_note_vi); fallow produces nothing (0).
limitations: Team heuristic values; no price statistic, statistical yearbook table or institute publication is cited.
Ignores price volatility, input cost and local market access; it is an ordering aid, not a profit estimate (profit stays unknown, G7).
Used only in production_value_index = Σ_seasons season_value_weight(window) × value_index(crop).

heat.note: Spikelet sterility rises when Tmax >~35C at anthesis (Satake & Yoshida 1978).

crops.market_note_vi: Lúa OM/ST ngắn ngày (90-105 ngày), đầu ra ổn định qua thương lái/doanh nghiệp; giá phụ thuộc xuất khẩu.
limitations: Stage lengths are a short-duration Mekong variety split, not FAO-56 long-season values.
Kc end 0.75 is a mid-value of FAO-56 range 0.90-0.60 (depends on drain-down timing).
Rice is most salt-sensitive at seedling and flowering; a single seasonal threshold overstates tolerance there.
Root depth is FAO-56 shallow-puddled soil value; p=0.20 is only relevant if not ponded.
ecw_threshold_ds_m approximated as ECe/1.5 (FAO-29 convention ECe ~ 1.5 ECw); salinity values are Maas-Hoffman steady-state, not Mekong-calibrated.
